sampleReviews.title: Excellent Local TTV Reception Withouyt Using Antenna Amplifier
sampleReviews.body: This is a review of EOHIBOV's HD Digital Indoor or Outdoor TV Antenna with Long Distance Range, Antenna Amplifier, and supports Ultra HD 4K 1080P. The antenna may be placed indoors or outdoors. I placed mine in a room at a window pointing towards the area where most all of our local TV broadcast antennas are located. The wire coming off the physical antenna that connects to the TV is about 30 feet long, so it was convenient to have the TV a good distance from the actual antenna. The antenna wire is to be connected to the included antenna amplifier (with or without the amplifier being powerered thru the USB cable). Since I wasn't using a digital converter box, I connected the antenna amplifier to the TV's coaxial antenna port using the cable that came with the unit. If you're using a digital converter box, you would attach the cable from the antenna to the amplifier (as before) and then connect the amplifier to the digital converter box. The digital converter box is then connected to the TV. NOTE: A USB-A to amplifier cord is supplied with the unit, but there is no wall unit power adapter to plug the USB-A connector into. The manual recommends plugging the USB-A connector into the back of the TV (which may or may not exist on the back of the TV). I live in a 100 square mile metropolitan area that has the major TV networks and some minor TV channels. This TV antenna picked up all of the channels without using power input into the amplifier. I did not use the USB-A-based 5volt power adapter to boost its signal reception. The reception was VERY GOOD. I did not test the 1080p HD reception capability.

sampleReviews.title: Very cheap mediocre antenna THAT FAILS AFTER EVERY RAIN
sampleReviews.body: I bought this same antenna . This antenna is JUNK. I mounted it outdoors and it only pulls in about 3/4 of the channels in the area. Everytime it rains I lose half the channels. I bought one of those $9 5x7 antennas you tape to the wall indoors and now I get 214 channels instead of 124. THIS ANTENNA IS JUNK
